hooks.name: is_pathfindable
hooks.doc: Changes whether a path of a `PathComputationType` (`Land`, `Water` or `Air`) may go through a block state. `event.pathfindable` starts with the block's own answer. The answer depends on the state and the type alone: the game asks once per state and type when parts resolve, at world load and on every `/reload`, so path finding and spawning read the stored answer and a part cannot answer from a position, level or time.
